dedupe_keys.name: tsukuba research building multiyear microgrid measurements

description: This Figshare item contains multiyear measurements from the microgrid serving a research building in Tsukuba, Japan. The Scientific Data descriptor connects building consumption, on-site generation and microgrid operation across multiple years, giving a real-site time series for calibrating or testing dispatch and demand models. The Figshare item is the named data child under the article collection. Its site-specific equipment, research-building occupancy and local climate make it unsuitable as a representative profile for other microgrids without adjustment. Time stamps and measurement channels need inspection before joining it to weather or tariff inputs in a simulator. All 1 member item(s) state CC0 in the Figshare article API; the collection DataCite registration says CC BY 4.0. I checked the article and named repository metadata but did not download the series, inspect missing values or run a dispatch model. No directly related catalogue record was found.
